about: I began my journey into software development in 2015 while working as a systems administrator at a university. A year later, I transitioned into professional development, taking on freelance work in PHP and JavaScript for a local fintech startup. After earning a degree in Computer Science and Entrepreneurship, I entered the Salesforce ecosystem and launched my consulting career in Colorado. Since then, I’ve had the opportunity to build impactful solutions for organizations of all sizes, moving fluidly between consulting roles and internal engineering teams.

My passion lies in solving frustrating software problems—the kind that make users want to throw their monitors out the window. I focus on creating reliable, user-friendly systems that help people do their jobs more efficiently and with less stress. Today, I’m based in the Netherlands, where I lead the development of high-quality scheduling solutions at GoMeddo.

When I’m not coding, you’ll likely find me running, traveling, playing music (guitar, bass, or saxophone), experimenting with 3D printing, exploring Utrecht by bike, or spending time with my wife and our dog, Artie.
